card.name: Linking words before a time period
card.fires_on: The small word or space right after "in" or after a dose, just before a time span such as "24 hours", "90 days" or "12 hours later". It appears in dosing limits and schedules.

modes.label: Limit per time span
modes.description: The space or "in" after a maximum amount, just before a period like 24 hours or 30 days.

modes.description: The space after a dose, just before a delay such as "12 hours later" or "3 to 8 days later".
